text:
mika: Quick sync — we need a prioritized, customer-driven checklist of gen API edge cases for the upcoming launch. Focus: streaming truncation, token limits, retry semantics, and customer rollback paths. Who can pair on a compact PRD fragment?

alana: I can start a short PRD fragment. Will call out acceptance criteria and specific repros from two enterprise customers.

devin: I have the telemetry for recent truncation incidents (logs + sample prompts). Will paste snippets and token counts.

sean: Please include explicit behavior for: streaming cutoff, resume semantics, idempotency, and fallback to smaller models. Customers care about deterministic retry outcomes.

alia: From support: 3 asks recurring — (1) clear error codes for truncation vs token limit, (2) guidance on client-side resume+dedupe, (3) a default server-side retry policy that is safe for payment idempotency.

mika: Perfect. Let's enumerate edge cases first, then map to acceptance criteria and launch gates. Minimal doc expectations: 1) repro for each edge case (short snippet + exact model/config), 2) automated test or smoke script, 3) monitoring knobs (metric name + alert threshold), 4) owner.

devin: I'll paste one example repro we saw: 
```
model: rwd-open-7b
prompt: "Summarize article:" + very long blob (~95k chars)
observed: stream emits "[TRUNCATED]" event, then connection closed at token=20480
notes: client retried, server returned 400 with code TOKEN_LIMIT
```
This will be a repro for truncation vs token limits.

alana: High-level edge-case list draft: 
- streaming cutoff mid-token (partial token in last chunk)
- resume after cutoff (client resumes at last confirmed token)
- retry with idempotency key (exactly-once semantics)
- fallback to smaller model when cost/latency spike or quota hit
- ambiguous error codes (map to distinct canonical codes)
- long-prompt enumeration (embedding+chunking interactions)

sean: For each item add acceptance criteria like: 
- cutoff mid-token: "No invalid UTF-8 in final assembled string; final token boundaries preserved in >99.9% of runs"
- resume: "Resume API must accept last_token_index and produce continuation consistent with original stream (byte-for-byte on golden test)"
- retry idempotency: "Replaying same idempotency key results in identical top-level response or a 409 CONFLICT with stable output id available"

alia: Monitoring: suggest metrics -> gen.stream.cutoffs{model}, gen.retries{reason}, gen.resume.success_rate. Alerts if cutoff rate > 0.1% p50 or resume failure > 1% over 1h.

mika: Launch gates proposal: must have repro + automated smoke for top 4 edge cases, QA sign-off, and two customer-run validation sessions (one hosted, one dedicated). Rollout staged: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic rollback on alerts.

product-bot: NOTE: Added rollout policy template to /playbooks/rollouts (internal). Refer to rollout-id: rl-2026-001.

devin: Quick question on retry semantics: do we want server to auto-retry transient infra errors, or surface them to clients to decide? Customers want predictable billing and idempotency.

alana: Recommendation: server auto-retries only for internal infra transient errors if idempotency key is present and we can guarantee no double-charge (or if operation is read-only). Otherwise surface transient error and provide clear retry suggestions.

sean: Also add fallback model routing policy: if model-latency > 3s p95 or available_slots < 5% then route to compatible smaller variant with a header `x-rwd-fallback: model-variant`. Must be documented in API and visible in Console.

alia: Support playbook snippet suggestion for customers: 
- If you see TOKEN_LIMIT -> reduce max_tokens or use resume flow.
- If you see TRUNCATION -> try chunked prompts or set streaming:false for determinism.

mika: Action items: 
1) @alana draft PRD fragment (include example repros + acceptance criteria) — owner: alana — due EOD tomorrow.
2) @devin attach telemetry + smoke script snippets to PRD — owner: devin — due EOD today.
3) @sean define api-level resume contract & idempotency semantics — owner: sean — block until we agree on exact response codes.
4) @alia write support playbook and customer-facing FAQ — owner: alia — due 2 business days.

deploy-bot: Build pipeline: gen-edge-tests smoke job queued (job id: 87421).

alana: I'll start the PRD in the product board and link here. Will flag decision points inline.

mika: Great. Final ask — include one concrete customer scenario per edge case (customer name redacted) so sales/SEs can reproduce during validation. Keep updates in this thread so we can keep a single source for rollout. :thumbsup:
